claims: Sinners (2026) won four Oscars at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners (2026) received a record-breaking 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners (2026) set a record for the most losses (12) in Oscar history.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners (2026).
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners (2026).
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners (2026).
Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Score at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners (2026).
Autumn Durald Arkapaw became the first woman to win the Best Cinematography award.
Michael B. Jordan won his first Oscar for his lead role in Sinners (2026).
Sinners (2026) lost in the Best Picture category to One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won six awards total at the 98th Academy Awards.
